scenarios.name: Read and share retained audio at standard and largest text sizes
scenarios.given: an idle conversation has retained synthetic audio and identified transcript speakers, in portrait at standard or largest accessibility text size
scenarios.when: the full transcript reader opens and the first identified speaker is brought into view with ordinary reader scrolling
scenarios.then: Saved audio and Share audio show complete words without clipping or truncation, elapsed and duration remain on one line, Play, position and Share are wholly visible and usable, and enough transcript remains visible to reach the same first speaker without starting playback

scenarios.name: Read delayed Mac saved-audio lines in recording order and play the original part
scenarios.given: a saved Mac conversation contains delayed finalized microphone and system lines, equal timestamps, an untimed boundary, legacy lines, duplicate restored segment IDs and a subsequent recording with retained local audio
scenarios.when: the reader expands History's Play from a line list, selects the rendered lines and closes that audio view
scenarios.then: timed lines within each explicit recording block appear in stable chronological order while untimed boundaries and legacy arrival order remain intact; each actual row plays its original source file and recording-relative offset, canonical transcript and saved files remain unchanged, and leaving the view stops playback

manual.reason: Native controls and silent temporary recordings prove display and seek mapping, not acoustic two-source acceptance or an installed production app.
steps: In the source-matched installed Mac candidate, inspect the expanded saved-audio list and confirm a delayed line plays the intended retained recording.
Keep issue 336's independent near-end, overlap, repeated speech and physical route matrix open until separately observed.
